notes.title: Slider is Thinky Awards' Best Free Game!
notes.content:
Guys... we did it! 

Despite the stacked line up of amazing free games, Slider managed to be the 2024 Thinky Awards' Best Free Puzzle Game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/56e905502bfdb0afb0460359088fed41cba4855b.png[/img]
[i]5 Big Booms for Slider please![/i]

This is probably the last award we will be getting given Slider's expiring shelf life (though we are still constantly getting new players which is awesome!), but it's been an amazing time releasing a game that has captured so many. Every time I see someone asking "Why is this game free?", I can't help but smile. 

Things have stalled out a bit, but there are still a few more projects that I'm hoping to get to before closing the book on Slider. 

Thank you again for all of your dedicated support, it truly means the world to me! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/7a20c75a03d700586f913f8e23a6d5d135b36a6f.png[/img]

notes.title: Nominate Slider for Most Innovative Gameplay!
notes.content:
I have a dream... that one day I'll see those words next to our game

"Overwhelmingly Positive"

Only 300 more reviews to go!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/596d2193762e126fb41d6b173b0f689b6f35acca.gif[/img]

Slider has been such a journey and I've been wayyy too addicted to constantly reading the reviews. I'm doing my best to keep up with the bugs (which have been for the most part kept up with?!) and in the coming months we should be able to start rolling out localization! 

Anyway, thanks again to everyone who's been reporting bugs and everyone who's been writing reviews. It's made the whole team super happy to read all the positive feedback and I've been glad that I've been able to find the time to keep supporting the game.

notes.title: Slider v1.0.09

notes.title: Slider v1.0.08
notes.content:
- Updated Linux Steam cloud saving path. If you created a Windows profile, it might overwrite the Linux one you currently have! You should be able to use the new "restore backup" function to get your old linux save back though.
  - If you messed up your saves, you can try checking your saves folder and using one of the other backups we create. For example, you might want to (while the game isn't running) copy "backup-LINUX-slider0.cat" to "backup-slider0.cat". If you start your game, you should be able to then restore the backup. The linux save path should be the games install directory -- during testing mine was at "~/snap/steam/common/.config/unity3d/slider*.cat" before the update, and at "~/snap/steam/common/.config/unity3d/boomo/Slider/slider*.cat" after the update.

- Updated select profile screen. Now there's a button to restore backups in case your save gets deleted by Steam cloud or something weird happens. (Backups are created/replaced each time you quit the game)
- Added an experimental "Keyboard Only" mode in controls
- Updated Barron's dialogue
- Fixed an issue with Factory Slider 9 collectible saving/loading

notes.title: Slider v1.0.07
notes.content:
- Updated how achievements are given. Now, teleporting to a different area will *only* disable speedrun achievements. In other works, teleporting, anchor, scroll + boots buttons are okay if you want area-specific achievements!
- Anchor cheats button now turns into a recall anchor button if you had already used it. [spoiler]You can normally already do this with the scroll of realigning's save/load though![/spoiler]
- Fixed a bug where the speedrun achievements weren't properly given. You should be able to load back into any speedrun saves you have and get them again though
- Actually updated profiles so that they show a dark gray border on the bottom if you used the cheats panel -- this is intended for speedrun verification if that ever picks up in the future
- Added another hint to the NPC in the caves by the big fungus
- Fixed a bug in MagiTech where [spoiler]quitting during the portal effect would break the portal[/spoiler]

notes.title: Slider Releases... for FREE!
notes.content:
Slider is now available!

After an amazing 3 year journey Slider has finally been released. Thank you to all everyone who has followed along, playtested, and wishlisted over the years. We couldn’t have done it without you.

[previewyoutube=QDoBvHqgbXE;full][/previewyoutube]

Please let us know if you run into any bugs!!!! To be honest we weren't able to test on non-Windows versions so there might be some issues there. You can send me an email at daniel@boomo.me or reach out to me on Twitter @_boomo_ or Discord @boomo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/7a20c75a03d700586f913f8e23a6d5d135b36a6f.png[/img]

notes.title: Slider Releases for FREE in Under 2 Weeks!
notes.content:
We can hardly believe it! It's been a long 3 year journey since our little game jam prototype was finished, but here we are nearing the big release. We've made it to so many festivals and won awards and done so many things that I never even dreamed would be possible. 

We hope you'll enjoy the game as much as we've had fun making it, thank you for waiting so long.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/aafdbd950af46187d8ab9e68dff33868e2879616.gif[/img]

[h3]Festivals[/h3]

We're super lucky to have squeaked into the IGF Celebration Days festival! We might have a stream at the end of the week, so be sure to check that out. 

Are you in Georgia? Make sure to come to our booth at the Southern-Fried Gaming Expo, July 19-21. You can play the full version of our game a few days early and say hi to us!

We should also be participating in another festival after all this as well, so keep an eye out for that too!

[h3]Playtesting[/h3]

Are you interested in playtesting Slider? We would really appreciate it! You can sign up for our beta to try the game early here: https://forms.gle/xSRUAcGR2RqA6xf39

[h3]Music[/h3]

Woah, Slider's OST is coming to Spotify (and others)! Stay tuned for more info on that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/7a20c75a03d700586f913f8e23a6d5d135b36a6f.png[/img]

notes.title: Slider's Release Date is Out!
notes.content:
🎉 It's finally coming out! 🎉

After two long years and an incredible journey, we're happy to finally announce our release date:

[h3]July 24th, 2024[/h3]

We hope you're as excited as we are for the game to come out. Make sure to follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/_boomo_]@_boomo_[/url] for any updates and future announcements.

notes.title: Slider Wins IGF (a late announcement)! and more!
notes.content:
Can you believe it?! Slider takes home "Best Student Game" at the Independent Games Festival! Huge, huge thank you for all the support we've received along the way. Even from such a small game, every comment we get and all the support from experts means so much to me and the entire team. It's super motivating and exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/f491f9e1553ea20464cfcf6448db14e7d3c3a014.png[/img]

In other news, we're still making good progress on the game -- areas are slowly but surely being checked off and bugs are being squished when found. If you're interested in trying our latest build of the game with all new -- voices! areas! achievements! more cats! -- come check us out at Southern-Fried Gaming Expo's July 28-30.

Let us know what you think! Or if you want a sticker! o7

notes.title: Slider @ GDC (And IGF Finalist!)
notes.content: Slider is at GDC this year as a finalist for the Independent Games Festival! Come by and check us out at the IGF pavilion if you’re here!

notes.title: Slider is a GDC IGF Finalist!
notes.content:
Wow! I never would have thought that we would make it this far, but look where we are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42262092/3ea088e432215173ba3a17e4d02a5721834eadd7.png[/img]

Big shout out to all the support we've received, it's been quite a journey (and there's still more to come). If you think we can beat games like TUNIC and Neon White in audience votes, then make sure to give Slider some support in the IGF Audience vote: https://informa-tech.formstack.com/forms/25th_annual_independent_games_festival_audience_award

We'll see you @ GDC! ;)
